title: Single-Cell and Bulk Transcriptomics Identify GNGT1-High Malignant Epithelial Cells Associated With Immune Suppression in Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma.
snippet: Esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) features epithelial heterogeneity and an immunosuppressive microenvironment, yet clinically relevant malignant epithelial states remain poorly defined.
